static_traits.name: 谢欣雅
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends somewhat strained (frequently talking politics), has a few friends to confide daily problems in
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received before；过去not yet出现类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作度高；能具体描述Anxiety影响；在政治话题中倾向理性分析与信息搜寻；语气显Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直担心自己会投错人，他们会把国家搞毁。这种担心带来了Anxiety和without助感。
basic_info.core_demands: “我真的只想not再感到如此overwhelmed和without助。我希望能在have not持续恐惧‘把一切变得更糟’的情况下做出决定。”
growth_experiences: 在上一次选举周期开始出现与政治相关的担忧与Anxiety，面对大量信息与意见感到overwhelmed；当前政治环境加剧此类担忧，临近选举时Anxiety升高，几乎每天在接触政治新闻或讨论时都会trigger。尝试通过研究候选人与政策缓解not确定感，却使Anxiety worsened；随之出现睡眠差、饮食规律受影响、Tense relationships with friends以及Mild decline in work performance。

core_beliefs: 我必须做出绝对正确的选择，否则后果将是灾难
我的决定会带来严重负面影响

special_situations.event: 看到电视或网络上的政治新闻或讨论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not掌握全部信息、without法做出完美选择，就会选错并导致国家被毁
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍研究候选人与政策、持续获取更多信息以避免错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一定会选错，他们会把国家搞毁

special_situations.event: 选举临近、投票日逐步逼近
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能保证做出完全正确的选择，后果将not可挽回
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复比较候选人、难以停止思考，强迫性关注政治相关内容
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 时间越近我越恐慌，我可能without法做出正确决定

special_situations.event: 与朋友聊天时频繁谈及政治，对方显得厌倦
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人not认同或not参与讨论，说明我have not尽到责任、我需要更努力证明自己了解充分
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断提出政治话题、寻求他人的意见与认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我很烦，我必须搞清楚，否则就是我的错

special_situations.event: 为缓解not确定感而大量研究候选人与政策
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not yet掌握所有细节，就必定会选错人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续阅读与比对信息、加深研究范围与强度
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我知道得还not够，现在做出的决定会害了国家

core_conflict.wish: Longs to become a responsible citizen who makes correct choices, affirmed in their judgment and worth
core_conflict.fear: Fears that a wrong choice will lead to catastrophic consequences and being blamed as the cause of 'the country going downhill'
defense_goal: 通过not断研究与理性分析来降低not确定性、避免犯错以缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 过度负责、容易内疚的承担者
object_relations.object_representation: 他人/媒体为批评者与审判者，选举与政治为not可控的巨大力量

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes 'one person's vote is only part of the bigger picture' and tries to reduce their excessive sense of responsibility
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者可能体验为：如果放松责任感，就是not够认真或not负责任
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes data, policy details, and logical deduction, avoiding subjective feeling expression; the tone is serious and restrained, with fewer emotion words.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被建议减少政治新闻摄入、设定信息边界时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心减少信息会导致错误选择，从而造成严重后果
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Opposes the limitation of information on the grounds of 'must fully understand / it is my responsibility'; speech rate on the fast side, nervous tone, continually giving counterexamples.

manifestations: 面对投票选择的Freedom产生沉重的责任感与选择Anxiety
将个人一票视为决定国家走向的关键，担心错误选择会带来灾难
在信息过载与意见分歧中感到not确定与overwhelmed
outcomes: Sleep impaired与饮食规律被打乱

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 自责并将选举结果高度个人化（“全是我的错”）
对做出“完美决定”的自我要求过高，反复审视与纠结

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“我必须/应该做对”为准则看待投票
将“必须全面了解信息才能投票”的外在要求当作绝对标准

positive_force: 对公共事务有较强的责任感与关切
主动寻求专业帮助并愿意尝试设定信息边界
具备信息检索与理性分析的能力
能觉察trigger情境（政治新闻/讨论）并提出初步自我管理策略
negative_force: 灾难化、预测not yet来与非黑即白思维显著
个人化与过度自责，加重负担感
信息过载与强迫性关注，导致Anxiety维持与升级
Sleep and diet affected降低情绪耐受度
Tense relationships with friends，进一步减少情感支持的可用性

target_behavior.behavior: 在政治相关情境下的强迫性信息搜寻与反复担忧
antecedent: 临近选举、想到即将投票
在社交对话中出现政治话题
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化与预测not yet来的认知、将选举结果高度个人化并对“必须做对”持非黑即白的要求，试图通过信息掌控缓解not确定感
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与错误决策的恐惧，短期内以获取更多信息来降低Anxiety感
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified、睡眠与饮食规律受损、Interpersonal tension、Mild decline in work performance
